attempts.sql: SELECT s.symbol_id FROM code.symbols s JOIN code.class_bases b ON s.symbol_id = b.class_symbol_id JOIN code.symbols base ON b.base_symbol_id = base.symbol_id WHERE s.file_id = 'src/click/core.py' AND s.qualname LIKE 'Group.%' AND base.qualname = 'Command' AND s.name = base.name AND s.kind = 'method' AND base.kind = 'method' AND s.line_start >= base.line_start AND s.line_start <= base.line_end

request:
Which methods of the Group class in src/click/core.py override a method that its base class Command (same file) defines itself under the same name? Count only methods written in the body of Command, not ones Command inherits; __init__ counts as an override. Give the symbol ID of the Group method.

Requested output columns: symbol_id (string).
explanation: The query finds symbols in src/click/core.py whose qualified name starts with 'Group.', then joins to class_bases to locate the Command base class. It filters to methods that share the same name as a method defined directly in Command (by checking the Command method's line range) and are themselves methods defined in the Group class, counting __init__ as an override.
sql: SELECT s.symbol_id FROM code.symbols s JOIN code.class_bases b ON s.symbol_id = b.class_symbol_id JOIN code.symbols base ON b.base_symbol_id = base.symbol_id WHERE s.file_id = 'src/click/core.py' AND s.qualname LIKE 'Group.%' AND base.qualname = 'Command' AND s.name = base.name AND s.kind = 'method' AND base.kind = 'method' AND s.line_start >= base.line_start AND s.line_start <= base.line_end
